subset.note: Placeholder selection so the entrypoint is runnable. #682 commits the sized, stratified subset (case_ids) before activation.

intended_cadence: Tuesday and Thursday at 12:00 Israel local time, two weeks, four experiments.

stop_condition.action: Activation (maintainer, after #682 ratifies the subset) writes the four experiment dates, each with its arms, and the window end date. A scheduled run refuses to execute before they are written, on any other date, after window_end, and once max_experiments experiment refs exist, whether or not the Routine is still enabled.

failure_policy: A missed or failed experiment is recorded as such and is not made up: it still counts toward max_experiments, the schedule does not shift, and no code path extends the window. Extension needs explicit maintainer authorization recorded in an issue and a new spec.
removal_path: Disable the Routine (provider side), delete this spec, run_concurrency_experiment.py, benchmark_concurrency_workers.py, concurrency-experiment.md and their tests; keep the claude/concurrency-experiment-* refs until #682 has read them.
